title: Yearbook and Detention
author: Ada Montrose
blurb: Xanthe Dravenmoor, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
